meta.title: C# 14 Language Syntax (.NET 10)
meta.description: Railroad diagrams for C# 14 — declarations, statements, expressions, pattern matching, LINQ, and C# 14 features including extension members, field keyword, and partial constructors.

Compilation Unit.description: Top-level structure of a C# source file

Using Directive.description: Import types, namespaces, or create aliases

Namespace Declaration.description: Organize types into namespaces — block-scoped or file-scoped (C# 10)

Type Declaration.description: All type declaration forms with attributes and modifiers

Class Declaration.description: Class with optional generics, primary constructor (C# 12), base types

Record Declaration.description: Record type with optional positional parameters and value semantics

Struct Declaration.description: Value type — supports ref, readonly, and primary constructors (C# 12)

Interface Declaration.description: Contract type — supports default implementations (C# 8+) and static abstracts (C# 11)

Enum Declaration.description: Enumeration type with optional underlying integral type

Extension Declaration.description: C# 14: Extension members for a target type — replaces static class extension methods

Member Declaration.description: Members of a type — methods, properties, fields, constructors, events, operators, nested types

Method Declaration.description: Method with optional generics — block body, expression body, or abstract

Property Declaration.description: Auto-property, full property, or expression-bodied — supports field keyword (C# 14)

Accessor List.description: Property/indexer accessors — get, set, init with optional bodies using field keyword (C# 14)

Field Declaration.description: Field with optional initializer — multiple declarators allowed

Event Declaration.description: Event with field-like or accessor syntax — supports partial (C# 14)

Constructor Declaration.description: Instance or static constructor with optional base/this chaining — supports partial (C# 14)

Indexer Declaration.description: Indexer with accessor-based or expression body

Parameter List.description: Formal parameter list for methods, constructors, lambdas, etc.

Type Parameters.description: Generic type parameter declaration with optional variance

Type.description: All type forms — predefined, generic, nullable, tuple, array, pointer, ref, function pointer

Attribute.description: Metadata annotation with optional target specifier

Variable Declaration.description: Local variable with type inference (var) or explicit type

If Statement.description: Conditional branching with optional else/else-if chain

For Statement.description: C-style for loop with initializer, condition, and iterator

Foreach Statement.description: Iterate over a collection — supports await foreach for async streams (C# 8+)

Try-Catch-Finally.description: Exception handling with catch filters (C# 6+) and optional finally

Using Statement.description: Resource management with automatic disposal — declaration form (C# 8+)

Yield Statement.description: Iterator method yield control — return or break

Primary Expression.description: Highest-precedence expressions — literals, invocations, member access, etc.

Lambda Expression.description: Anonymous function with expression or block body — supports attributes and return type

Pattern.description: All pattern forms for is-expressions and switch arms (C# 7–14)

With Expression.description: Non-destructive mutation — create a copy with modifications (C# 9+)

Range Expression.description: Range operator for slicing arrays, spans, and strings (C# 8+)

String Interpolation.description: Interpolated string with optional raw form (C# 11+)

Async Method.description: Async method pattern with Task-based return types

Argument List.description: Arguments passed to method calls, constructors, indexers
